summary: Require cached resource identity to agree before direct aliases or synthesized patterns become exact recall hits.
reason: Canonical teaching overlap and substituted identifier existence cannot erase an explicit conflicting cached identity.
validated_outcome: Actual CLI regressions cover literal/cross-alias direct conflicts, pattern and combined-path conflicts, true cached aliases, warned absent resources, and unchanged empty-identity classifications. Ambiguous direct aliases require a shared query/teaching/resource canonical; ordinary mismatch warnings name the actual cached alternative.
